title: Bino Report Bundle
description: Configuration documents used by bino build to collect data and render reports.

apiVersion.description: API version of the report bundle. Must always be 'bino.bi/v1alpha1' for this schema.

kind.description: Type of document in the report bundle (e.g. DataSource, DataSet, LayoutPage). Determines which spec block is expected.

metadata.description: Standard object metadata used to name and label this document. The name is used by other documents to reference this one.

spec.description: Kind-specific configuration payload. Its structure depends on the value of 'kind' (for example dataSourceSpec for kind=DataSource).

params.description: Parameter definitions for this LayoutPage. When the page is referenced with params, these define the expected parameter names, types, and validation rules.

Parameter definitions for this document. Supported on LayoutPage and referenceable component kinds (Text, Table, ChartStructure, ChartTime, Tree, Grid, LayoutCard, Image). When the document is referenced with params, these define the expected parameter names, types, and validation rules.

name.description: Name of this document. Must be unique per kind within each ReportArtefact after applying constraints. Used for references from other manifests (for example a DataSet query or LayoutPage child). Allowed characters: letters, digits, hyphen and underscore (e.g. 'coffee_sales_daily'), optionally prefixed with a registry scope '@scope/' (e.g. '@acme/revenue-table') for documents pulled from a bino registry. For DataSource documents the name is additionally constrained: either a lowercase SQL identifier (matching ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$), or a full '@scope/name' registry identity — because it becomes the DuckDB view name, a '@scope/name' DataSource must be double-quoted when referenced in a DataSet's raw SQL query, e.g. FROM "@acme/revenue-table".

labels.description: Key-value pairs for categorization. ReportArtefact labels are used as context when evaluating constraints on other documents.

annotations.description: Key-value pairs for arbitrary metadata. Not used by the system.

description.description: Optional free-form description of this document's purpose or contents.

oneOf.description: String format constraint: 'field operator value', e.g., 'mode==preview', 'labels.env in [dev,staging]'

operator.description: Comparison operator: '==' (equals), '!=' (not equals), 'in' (value in array), 'not-in' (value not in array)

value.description: Value to compare: string or boolean for ==, !=; string array for in, not-in

oneOf.description: Structured format constraint with field, operator, and value

constraints.description: Constraint expressions that determine if this document is included for a specific ReportArtefact. Each constraint is evaluated against the target artefact's labels, spec, and the current mode (build/preview/serve). All constraints must match for inclusion. Supports both string format ('mode==preview', 'labels.env in [dev,staging]') and structured format ({field: 'mode', operator: '==', value: 'preview'}). Not applicable to ReportArtefact documents.

type.description: Kind of asset to register: 'image' for logos and pictures, 'file' for generic binary files, 'font' for custom fonts used in layouts.

mediaType.description: MIME media type of the asset (for example 'image/png', 'image/svg+xml', 'font/woff2'). Used when embedding the asset into the report.

source.description: Where to load the asset from (inline base64, local file path, or remote URL). Exactly one source variant must be provided.

inlineBase64.description: Base64-encoded asset content embedded directly in the manifest. Useful for fully self-contained bundles.

localPath.description: Relative or absolute path to a local asset file (for example './assets/logo.png'). Resolved relative to the manifest file.

remoteURL.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL pointing to a remotely hosted asset (for example 'https://example.com/logo.svg').

sqlIdentifier.description: Name of the DuckDB view created from this DataSource. Either a valid unquoted SQL identifier in lowercase (letter or underscore followed by lowercase letters, digits, or underscores), for example 'coffee_sales_daily' — use this form directly (unquoted) in DataSet queries — or, for a DataSource pulled from a bino registry, its full '@scope/name' identity, for example '@acme/revenue-table'; reference this form double-quoted in DataSet queries, e.g. FROM "@acme/revenue-table".

dataFileFormat.description: File format of input data files. Choose 'csv', 'excel', 'parquet' or 'json' so DuckDB can parse the files correctly.

sampleConfig.description: DuckDB USING SAMPLE configuration. Use a number for an exact row count, a string for a percentage, or an object to also specify the sampling method.

oneOf.description: Number of rows to sample (for example 1000).
Percentage of rows to sample (for example '10%').

size.description: Number of rows or percentage to sample.

method.description: Sampling method. 'bernoulli' evaluates each row independently (good accuracy), 'system' samples entire vector chunks (faster, higher variance), 'reservoir' returns an exact row count.

inlineContent.description: Inline data rows embedded directly in the manifest, expressed either as a YAML array of objects or as a JSON array encoded as a string.

oneOf.description: Inline rows captured directly as a YAML/JSON array, for example: - {country: 'DE', cups: 10}.
Raw JSON array serialized as a multi-line string, for example '[{"country":"DE","cups":10}]'.

dataSourceSpec.description: Configuration for a DataSource that collects raw data from files, inline content, or external databases and exposes it as a DuckDB view.

type.description: How this datasource loads data. Use 'inline' for embedded data, file types ('excel', 'csv', 'parquet') for file-based sources, or 'postgres_query'/'mysql_query' to run a SQL query against an external database.

path.description: File path, directory, glob pattern or URL used by file-based datasources. For example './data/landing/*.csv' or 's3://bucket/path/data.parquet'. Required for types 'excel', 'csv' and 'parquet'.

sheet.description: Worksheet name to read for 'excel' datasources. When omitted, the first sheet is used.

query.description: SQL query to execute against the remote PostgreSQL or MySQL database. Required for 'postgres_query' and 'mysql_query' types. The query result populates the DuckDB view (for example 'SELECT * FROM sales').

ephemeral.description: Controls whether this datasource is always refetched or may be cached between builds. When not set, bino derives ephemerality from the source type: database queries and remote URLs are treated as changing, inline content and in-project files as stable. Set explicitly to false to enable caching even for remote or database sources (for example a static S3 dataset).

delimiter.description: Field delimiter character for CSV files (for example ';' or '|'). Defaults to auto-detection when not set.

header.description: Whether the CSV file has a header row. When true (the default), the first row defines column names.

skipRows.description: Number of lines to skip at the beginning of the CSV file before reading data.

thousands.description: Thousands separator in numeric values (for example '.' for '1.000.000').

decimalSeparator.description: Decimal point character in numeric values (for example ',' for '3,14').

columnNames.description: Explicit column names. Mutually exclusive with 'columns'.

dateFormat.description: Date format string using DuckDB strftime specifiers (for example '%d/%m/%Y').

columns.description: Map of column name to DuckDB type (for example 'amount': 'DECIMAL(10,2)'). Mutually exclusive with 'columnNames'.

sample.description: Sample a subset of rows from this datasource using DuckDB's USING SAMPLE clause. Ideal for working with large datasets during preview and development. Use a number for an exact row count (for example 1000), a string for a percentage (for example '10%'), or an object to specify a sampling method (bernoulli, reservoir, or system). Combine with constraints to disable sampling in production builds.

sqlConnection.description: Connection parameters for 'postgres_query' and 'mysql_query' datasources. This block defines all non-credential connection details (host, port, database, user). Credentials are provided separately via a ConnectionSecret referenced by the 'secret' field.

host.description: Database server hostname or IP address (for example 'db.example.com').

port.description: Database server port number (for example 5432 for PostgreSQL or 3306 for MySQL).

database.description: Name of the database to connect to (for example 'analytics').

schema.description: Database schema name (optional, defaults to 'public' for PostgreSQL).

user.description: Username for database authentication. The password must be provided via the referenced ConnectionSecret.

secret.description: Name of a ConnectionSecret manifest (kind: ConnectionSecret) that contains database credentials (password only). The secret type must match the datasource type (postgres or mysql). When set, DuckDB uses the named secret for authentication.

connectionSecretSpec.description: Connection secret configuration for S3, HTTP, PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc. Database secrets (postgres, mysql) contain only credentials; connection details (host, port, database, user) are defined in the DataSource connection block.

scope.description: Optional file path prefix that the secret applies to (e.g. s3://my-bucket).

provider.description: Secret provider (defaults to 'config'). Use 'credential_chain' for automatic discovery.

postgresAuthSpec.description: PostgreSQL credentials. Connection details (host, port, database, user) must be defined in the DataSource connection block.

passwordFromEnv.description: Name of environment variable containing the database password (recommended over inline password).

mysqlAuthSpec.description: MySQL credentials. Connection details (host, port, database, user) must be defined in the DataSource connection block.

passwordFromEnv.description: Name of environment variable containing the database password (recommended over inline password).

keyIdFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the AWS access key ID.

secretFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the AWS secret access key.

sessionToken.description: AWS session token for temporary credentials.

sessionTokenFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the AWS session token.

endpoint.description: Custom S3 endpoint URL (for S3-compatible services).

keyIdFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the GCS access key ID.

secretFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the GCS secret access key.

usernameFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the HTTP username.

passwordFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the HTTP password.

bearerTokenFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the HTTP bearer token.

httpProxy.description: HTTP proxy URL (e.g. 'http://proxy.example.com:8080'). Used for datasource HTTP access. Note: The CLI respects the http_proxy environment variable only for DuckDB extension downloads; datasource access requires explicit proxy configuration via this field or httpProxyFromEnv.

httpProxyFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the HTTP proxy URL (e.g. 'http_proxy'). Takes precedence if httpProxy is not set.

httpProxyUsernameFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the HTTP proxy username.

httpProxyPasswordFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the HTTP proxy password.

keyIdFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the R2 access key ID.

secretFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the R2 secret access key.

connectionStringFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the Azure connection string.

accountKeyFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the Azure account key.

tokenFromEnv.description: Environment variable containing the Hugging Face token.

oneOf.description: Inline SQL query executed against DuckDB to produce this dataset.
Reference to an external SQL file containing the query.

query.description: SQL query executed against DuckDB to produce this dataset. Refer to DataSource names (their metadata.name) as tables or views, for example 'SELECT * FROM coffee_datasource'. Inline dependencies can be referenced via @inline(N) syntax where N is the zero-based index. Can be an inline string or a file reference using $file syntax. Mutually exclusive with 'prql' and 'source'.

oneOf.description: Inline PRQL query (Pipelined Relational Query Language) executed against DuckDB.
Reference to an external PRQL file containing the query.

prql.description: PRQL query (Pipelined Relational Query Language) executed against DuckDB. Can be an inline string or a file reference using $file syntax. The PRQL is compiled to SQL by DuckDB's prql extension. See https://prql-lang.org for syntax. Mutually exclusive with 'query' and 'source'.

source.description: Direct DataSource pass-through. When set, the DataSet becomes an alias for the referenced DataSource without transformation. Can be a string reference to a named DataSource or an inline DataSource definition. Mutually exclusive with 'query' and 'prql'.

dependencies.description: List of DataSource dependencies. Each item can be a string reference to a named DataSource or an inline DataSource definition. Inline DataSources are referenced in queries via @inline(N) syntax where N is the zero-based index.

$file.description: Relative path to an external file. The path is resolved relative to the manifest file containing this reference. Changes to the referenced file trigger cache invalidation and auto-reload in preview mode.

fileReference.description: Reference to an external file using the $file syntax. Supports SQL (.sql) and PRQL (.prql) files for queries.

dataSourceRefUnion.description: Reference to a DataSource by name OR an inline DataSource definition.

oneOf.description: Name of a DataSource document (metadata.name).
Inline DataSource definition.

inlineDataSourceSpec.description: Inline DataSource definition embedded directly in a DataSet or component. Same structure as dataSourceSpec but without requiring a separate document.

path.description: File path, directory, glob pattern or URL for file-based datasources.

sheet.description: Worksheet name to read for 'excel' datasources. When omitted, the first sheet is used.

query.description: SQL query for postgres_query and mysql_query types.

delimiter.description: Field delimiter character for CSV files.

header.description: Whether the CSV file has a header row.

skipRows.description: Number of lines to skip at the beginning of the CSV file.

decimalSeparator.description: Decimal point character in numeric values.

columnNames.description: Explicit column names. Mutually exclusive with 'columns'.

dateFormat.description: Date format string using DuckDB strftime specifiers.

columns.description: Map of column name to DuckDB type. Mutually exclusive with 'columnNames'.

sample.description: Sample a subset of rows from this datasource using DuckDB's USING SAMPLE clause.

datasetRefUnion.description: Reference to a DataSet by name OR an inline DataSet definition.

oneOf.description: Name of a DataSet document (metadata.name).
Inline DataSet definition.

inlineDataSetSpec.description: Inline DataSet definition embedded directly in a component. Supports query, prql, or source fields.

query.description: SQL query. Inline dependencies can be referenced via @inline(N) syntax. Mutually exclusive with 'prql' and 'source'.

prql.description: PRQL query. Mutually exclusive with 'query' and 'source'.

source.description: Direct DataSource pass-through. Mutually exclusive with 'query' and 'prql'.

dependencies.description: DataSource dependencies. Inline DataSources are referenced via @inline(N) syntax.

format.description: Logical page size of the rendered artefact (for example 'xga', 'a4', 'letter').

orientation.description: Page orientation of the artefact, either 'portrait' or 'landscape'.

language.description: Language code passed to the renderer (currently 'de' or 'en').

oneOf.description: Single pattern to select LayoutPages by metadata.name.
Array of LayoutPage references. Each item can be a string (name or glob pattern) or an object with page name and params.

layoutPages.description: LayoutPage references. Supports string patterns with glob syntax (*, ?, [abc]) or objects with page and params for parameterized pages. Pages appear in pattern order; within each pattern, pages are sorted alphabetically. Default: ['*'] (all pages).

filename.description: Output filename of the generated artefact (for example 'weekly-coffee-report.pdf').

title.description: Human-readable title of the artefact. Often reused in PDF metadata and UI.

description.description: Optional short description of the artefact contents, used in logs and metadata.

subject.description: Optional subject line stored in the PDF metadata.

author.description: Optional author or owning team name stored in the PDF metadata.

keywords.description: Optional list of keywords stored in PDF metadata to help search and classification (for example ['coffee', 'weekly', 'sales']).

signingProfile.description: Name of a SigningProfile manifest that should be used to digitally sign the generated PDF. If omitted, the artefact is not signed.

selectedStyle.description: Name of a ComponentStyle manifest (metadata.name) applied as the default style for every LayoutPage and component in this artefact. A selectedStyle set on a page, card, grid, tree, or leaf component overrides it (nearest ancestor wins). Maps to the selected-style HTML attribute.

i18nNamespace.description: I18n namespace inherited as the default by every LayoutPage and component in this artefact. An i18nNamespace set on a page, card, grid, tree, or leaf component overrides it (nearest ancestor wins).

title.description: Human-readable title of the live report application.

description.description: Optional description of the live report application.

routes.description: Map of URL paths to route configurations. The root route '/' is mandatory and serves as the index page. Other routes map to ReportArtefact documents by name.

artefact.description: Name of the ReportArtefact document to render for this route (metadata.name). Cannot be used together with layoutPages.

oneOf.description: Name of a single LayoutPage document to render.
Array of LayoutPage references. Each item can be a string (name or glob pattern) or an object with page name and params.

layoutPages.description: One or more LayoutPage documents to render for this route. Can use parameterized refs with page and params. Cannot be used together with artefact.

title.description: Optional page title override for this route.

queryParams.description: Query parameters allowed for this route. These are substituted like ${VAR} environment variables in the report documents.

name.description: Name of the query parameter. Must be a valid identifier (used as ${name} in documents).

type.description: Type of the parameter. Determines the input control in the serve UI. Default is 'string'.

default.description: Default value if the query parameter is not provided. If omitted and optional is false, the request returns HTTP 400.

optional.description: If true, the parameter is optional even without a default value. The parameter will be empty/undefined if not provided.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this parameter controls.

options.description: Options for select type parameters. Either static items or a dataset reference.

items.description: Static list of options for select type.

dataset.description: Name of a DataSet to load options from.

valueColumn.description: Column name in the dataset to use as the option value.

labelColumn.description: Column name in the dataset to use as the option label. If omitted, valueColumn is used.

min.description: Minimum value for number or number_range types.

max.description: Maximum value for number or number_range types.

step.description: Step increment for number or number_range types.

value.description: The value to submit when this option is selected.

label.description: Human-readable label for this option. If omitted, value is used.

name.description: Name of the parameter. Must be a valid identifier (used as ${name} in the LayoutPage).

type.description: Type of the parameter. Used for validation of passed values. Use 'date' for date-only (YYYY-MM-DD) and 'date_time' for date and time (ISO 8601).

default.description: Default value if the parameter is not provided. If omitted and required is true, an error is raised.

required.description: If true, the parameter must be provided when using this LayoutPage. Default is false.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this parameter controls.

options.description: Options for select type or constraints for number type (min, max).

oneOf.description: Name or glob pattern to select LayoutPage(s) by metadata.name.

page.description: Name of the LayoutPage to reference (must be exact name, not a glob pattern).

params.description: Parameter values to pass to the LayoutPage. Keys must match parameter names defined in the LayoutPage's metadata.params.

layoutPageRef.description: Reference to a LayoutPage, either as a string (name or glob pattern) or an object with page name and params.

oneOf.description: Name of a single LayoutPage document to render.
Array of LayoutPage references. Each item can be a string (name or glob pattern) or an object with page name and params.

layoutPages.description: One or more LayoutPage documents to render. Optional — when omitted, pages are auto-discovered from refs. Can use parameterized refs with page and params.

format.description: Logical viewport size for rendering (for example 'xga', 'hd', 'full_hd', '4k').

language.description: Language code passed to the renderer (currently 'de' or 'en').

filenamePrefix.description: Prefix for generated screenshot filenames (for example 'quarterly-report').

filenamePattern.description: Pattern for screenshot filenames: 'index' generates prefix-001.png, 'ref' generates prefix-refname.png.

imageFormat.description: Image format for screenshots, either 'png' or 'jpeg'.

quality.description: JPEG quality (1-100). Only applicable when imageFormat is 'jpeg'.

omitBackground.description: If true, captures screenshots with transparent background (PNG only).

scale.description: Screenshot scale: 'css' uses CSS pixels, 'device' uses device pixels.

refs.description: List of component references to capture screenshots of.

kind.description: Kind of the component to capture (for example 'ChartStructure', 'ChartTime', 'Table').

name.description: Name (metadata.name) of the component to capture.

format.description: Page format for the rendered document (for example 'a4', 'letter').

orientation.description: Page orientation of the document, either 'portrait' or 'landscape'.

locale.description: Locale for the document, used for i18n and the bn-context element (for example 'en', 'de', 'fr').

filename.description: Output filename of the generated PDF (for example 'user-guide.pdf').

title.description: Human-readable title of the document, stored in PDF metadata.

author.description: Optional author name stored in the PDF metadata.

subject.description: Optional subject line stored in the PDF metadata.

keywords.description: Optional list of keywords stored in PDF metadata.

oneOf.description: String array of markdown file paths or glob patterns (e.g., ['./docs/*.md', './intro.md']).
Legacy object array format (deprecated, use string array instead).

sources.description: Ordered list of markdown files to include in the document. Supports glob patterns (e.g., './docs/*.md').

stylesheet.description: Path to a custom CSS stylesheet for styling the document (relative to manifest file).

tableOfContents.description: If true, generates a table of contents from markdown headings.

tocNumbering.description: If true, adds hierarchical chapter numbers to TOC entries (e.g. 1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Only applies when tableOfContents is enabled.

math.description: If true, enables LaTeX math rendering via KaTeX. Use $...$ for inline math and $$...$$ for display math.

pageBreakBetweenSources.description: If true, inserts a page break between each source file.

signingProfile.description: Name of a SigningProfile manifest that should be used to digitally sign the generated PDF.

displayHeaderFooter.description: If true, displays a header and footer on each page of the PDF. Uses default templates if headerTemplate/footerTemplate are not specified.

headerTemplate.description: Custom HTML template for the page header. Supports Playwright template classes: 'date', 'title', 'url', 'pageNumber', 'totalPages'. If not specified and displayHeaderFooter is true, shows the document title centered.

footerTemplate.description: Custom HTML template for the page footer. Supports Playwright template classes: 'date', 'title', 'url', 'pageNumber', 'totalPages'. If not specified and displayHeaderFooter is true, shows date on left and page number on right.

marginTop.description: Top margin for header space (e.g., '20mm', '1in'). Only used when displayHeaderFooter is true.

marginBottom.description: Bottom margin for footer space (e.g., '15mm', '0.5in'). Only used when displayHeaderFooter is true.

file.description: Path to a markdown file (relative to the manifest file).

documentSource.description: Deprecated: Use string paths directly in the sources array instead of objects with file property.

datasetRef.description: Single or multiple dataset references. Each reference can be a string name or an inline DataSet definition.

oneOf.description: Name of a DataSet document (metadata.name).
Inline DataSet definition.
Array of DataSet references (string names or inline definitions).

selectedStyle.description: Name of a ComponentStyle manifest (metadata.name) to apply to this component. The effective style merges _system, then _default, then the named style. Maps to the selected-style HTML attribute.

i18nNamespace.description: I18n namespace consulted for this component's labels; keys missing there fall back to '_system'. Resolved at runtime from the nearest ancestor carrying one (card, page, tree, grid, or the artefact) when not set. Maps to the i18n-namespace HTML attribute.

value.description: Text content. Supports Markdown (converted to HTML at build time) and template expressions like ${data.myDataset[0].ac1}.

scale.description: Font-size scaling mode. "none" disables scaling, "auto" auto-scales silently, a positive number (e.g. "0.8") sets an explicit factor. When omitted, auto-scales and warns with the applied factor.

value.description: Scaling factor (pixels per data unit or pixels per percentage point). Referenced by chart/table components via unit-scaling or percentage-scaling attributes.

content.description: Component style configuration expressed as an object or JSON string.

IBCS rule-set configuration expressed as an object or JSON string. Rendered as the JSON body of a bn-ruleset element. A document named _default adjusts the global rule-set layer; any other name defines a named rule set selected via the ruleset attribute.

ruleSetContent.description: Rule-set configuration object. Partial overrides are deep-merged over the engine's built-in defaults.

scenarios.description: Per-scenario-prefix rule overrides, keyed by scenario prefix (e.g. ac, fc, pl, bu, pp, py, dac..dpy, drac..drpy, or user-defined prefixes).

fallback.description: Style applied to scenario names not present in scenarios.

colorIndex.description: IBCS color encoding: 10 = solid dark, 20 = light gray, 30 = hatched, 50 = outlined.

ruleSetScenarioRule.description: Rule overrides for one scenario prefix. Variants 1-4 are derived from the base values (e.g. name 'AC' becomes AC1..AC4, sortIndex + n*10).

name.description: Display base name; variants get 1..4 appended (e.g. 'AC' -> 'AC1').

colorIndex.description: IBCS color encoding: 10 = solid dark, 20 = light gray, 30 = hatched, 50 = outlined.

sortIndex.description: Base sort index for column ordering; variant n adds n*10.

globalStyle.description: Global typography and color settings applied to all components.

fontSizePx.description: Base font size in pixels. Default: 13.3333

fontFamily.description: CSS font-family value. Default: 'Noto Sans', sans-serif

fontBackgroundColor.description: Background color for text elements (CSS color). Default: #ffffff

textStyle.description: Style settings for bn-text components. Currently extensible for future use.

timeChartStyle.description: Style settings for bn-chart-time (column/time series charts).

stackColors.description: Ordered list of CSS colors for stacked segments. Segments cycle through these colors. Default: ["#000000", "#c0c0c0", "#808080"].

structureChartStyle.description: Style settings for bn-chart-structure (horizontal bar charts).

stackColors.description: Ordered list of CSS colors for stacked segments. Segments cycle through these colors. Default: ["#000000", "#c0c0c0", "#808080"].

treeStyle.description: Style settings for bn-tree (hierarchical tree diagrams).

edgeColor.description: Color for tree edges/connections (CSS color). Default: #404040

edgeWidth.description: Width of tree edges in pixels. Default: 1

operatorCircleRadius.description: Radius of operator node circles in pixels. Default: 10

operatorFontSizeScale.description: Scale factor for operator font size relative to global.fontSizePx. Default: 0.9

operatorColor.description: Color for operator nodes (CSS color). Default: #404040

scaleFactorsTimeChart.description: Scale factors for time chart element sizing (multiplied by global.fontSizePx).

scenarioOffset.description: Horizontal offset between scenario bars. Default: 0.3

scenarioLabelToColumn.description: Gap between scenario label and column. Default: 0.3

labelToColumn.description: Gap between category label and column. Default: 0.3

labelToAxis.description: Gap between label and axis. Default: 0.3

varianceAxisLineWidth.description: Width of variance axis lines. Default: 0.3

axisLineWidth.description: Width of main axis lines. Default: 0.1

scenarioLineWidth.description: Width of scenario indicator lines. Default: 0.2

markerWidth.description: Width of data point markers. Default: 0.7

markerOffset.description: Offset of markers from data points. Default: 0.0

axisTickLength.description: Length of axis tick marks. Default: 0.3

scaleFactorsStructureChart.description: Scale factors for structure chart element sizing (multiplied by global.fontSizePx).

scenarioOffset.description: Vertical offset between scenario bars. Default: 0.3

scenarioLabelToBar.description: Gap between scenario label and bar. Default: 0.1

labelToBar.description: Gap between category label and bar. Default: 0.3

labelToAxis.description: Gap between label and axis. Default: 0.3

varianceAxisLineWidth.description: Width of variance axis lines. Default: 0.3

axisLineWidth.description: Width of main axis lines. Default: 0.1

scenarioLineWidth.description: Width of scenario indicator lines. Default: 0.2

markerWidth.description: Width of data point markers. Default: 0.7

markerOffset.description: Offset of markers from data points. Default: 0.0

categoryWidth.description: Height allocated per category row. Default: 1.9

axisTickLength.description: Length of axis tick marks. Default: 0.3

svgStyleGroup.description: SVG styles grouped by scenario type (IBCS notation).

svgStyle.description: SVG styling properties for chart elements.

dasharray.description: SVG stroke-dasharray pattern (e.g., '10 5 5 5' for dashed lines).

fillpattern.description: Reference to a fill pattern (e.g., 'fc' for forecast hatching).

code.description: Locale code applied to the payload. Must exactly match a ReportArtefact language ('de' or 'en') to take effect; there is no BCP 47 normalization, so 'de-DE' never matches.

namespace.description: Lookup namespace the translations are stored under. Defaults to '_system', the namespace every component reads; entries merge over the built-in labels. A named namespace is only consulted by components whose i18nNamespace points at it.

content.description: Internationalization payload expressed as JSON or an inline object.

selectedStyle.description: Name of a ComponentStyle manifest (metadata.name) to apply to this component. The effective style merges _system, then _default, then the named style. Maps to the selected-style HTML attribute.

ruleset.description: Name of a RuleSet manifest (metadata.name) selecting the IBCS scenario rule set, or 'inherited-page' to reuse the rule set of the surrounding page. The effective rule set merges _system, then _default, then the named rule set. Forwarded to the page title and inherited by descendants that use 'inherited-closest' or 'inherited-page'. Maps to the ruleset HTML attribute.

titleBusinessUnit.description:
Name of the business unit displayed in card header. If empty, the business unit row is omitted. Supports inline Markdown (bold, italic, code, links, strikethrough) and inline HTML, converted to HTML at build time and sanitized before rendering. Use
for an explicit line break. Block Markdown (headings, lists, tables) is not interpreted, so a value like '1. Quartal 2024' stays literal.

titleNamespace.description: Deprecated: use i18nNamespace. Namespace used for title translations only; never applies to children.

i18nNamespace.description: I18n namespace for the page title and, via inheritance, all children (their own i18nNamespace wins). Takes precedence over the deprecated titleNamespace.

titleDateStart.description: Start date in yyyy-MM-dd format (e.g. 2023-01-01) or ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. 2023-01-01T14:30:00Z).

titleDateEnd.description: End date in yyyy-MM-dd format (e.g. 2023-12-31) or ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. 2023-12-31T23:59:59Z).

titleDateFormat.description: Date format. year: 'YYYY', quarter: 'Q[Q] YYYY', month: 'MMM YYYY', week: '[KW]WW YYYY', day: 'DD.MM.YYYY', time: 'DD.MM.YYYY HH:mm:ss', none: 'DD.MM.YYYY', auto: automatic detection.

titleDateLink.description: Format in which the start and end date are linked. If empty the date row is omitted. avg: 'Ø[DATE]', interval: '[DATE]..[DATE2]', start: '.[DATE]', end: '[DATE].', ytd: '_[DATE]', ytg: '[DATE]_', cum: '[DATE]_[DATE2]', mat: '~[DATE]', none: '[DATE]'.

titleMeasures.description: Array of measure objects with name and unit. If all units are the same, redundant units will be reduced and names concatenated. If unit is empty, the row is omitted. Can be a YAML array or a JSON string. Example: [{"name": "Bruttoumsatz", "unit": "mEUR"}]

titleScenarios.description: List of scenarios displayed in card header. Can be a YAML array or a comma-separated string. If empty, the scenarios are omitted. Values: ac1-ac4, fc1-fc4, pp1-pp4, pl1-pl4.

titleVariances.description: List of variances calculated from the given scenarios. Can be a YAML array or a comma-separated string. The scenarios used in the variances must also be defined in the scenarios property. Variance is defined as (ScenarioA - ScenarioB). The pos/neg/neu postfix defines which value is 'good' (positive or negative). If empty, variance charts are hidden. Pattern: d[scenarioB]_[scenarioA]_[pos/neg/neu].

titleOrder.description: Primary scenario on which the order direction is applied. If order is set to a scenario, it must also exist in the scenario list. If empty, the order arrow is omitted.

pageLayout.description: Layout mode for arranging child components. full: single slot. split-vertical/horizontal: two slots. NxN: equal grid. 1-over-2, etc.: asymmetric layouts. custom-template: uses pageCustomTemplate.

pageCustomTemplate.description: CSS grid-template-areas string for custom-template layout mode. Each quoted row defines a grid row; letters map to slot indices.

pageGridGap.description: Gap between grid cells in pixels.

pageFormat.description: Defines the size of the page.

pageOrientation.description: Defines page orientation. Default is based on the given format.

pageFitToContent.description: When true, the page body height shrinks to fit content. When false (default), the body stretches to fill the full page height. Use false when the page contains auto-scaling components.

pageNumber.description: Page number displayed in the footer.

footerDisplayPageNumber.description: Whether to display the page number in the footer.

messageImage.description: URL of the card's logo/pictogram. If not http, it looks up the URL in the component's asset folder. If empty, the image is omitted. Example: 'debug/concordia.png'.

messageText.description:
Message text displayed in the message row above the title. If empty, the message row is omitted. Supports inline Markdown (bold, italic, code, links, strikethrough) and inline HTML, converted to HTML at build time and sanitized before rendering. Use
for an explicit line break. Block Markdown (headings, lists, tables) is not interpreted.

layoutCardSpecBase.description: Configuration for a LayoutCard component. Cards are containers for child components (charts, tables, text) and support card-specific layout properties.

selectedStyle.description: Name of a ComponentStyle manifest (metadata.name) to apply to this component. The effective style merges _system, then _default, then the named style. Maps to the selected-style HTML attribute.

ruleset.description: Name of a RuleSet manifest (metadata.name) selecting the IBCS scenario rule set, or 'inherited-page' to reuse the rule set of the surrounding page. The effective rule set merges _system, then _default, then the named rule set. Forwarded to the card title and inherited by descendants that use 'inherited-closest'. Maps to the ruleset HTML attribute.

titleImage.description: URL of the card's title image. If not http, it looks up the URL in the component's asset folder. If empty, the image is omitted.

titleBusinessUnit.description:
Name of the business unit displayed in card header. If empty, the business unit row is omitted. Supports inline Markdown (bold, italic, code, links, strikethrough) and inline HTML, converted to HTML at build time and sanitized before rendering. Use
for an explicit line break. Block Markdown (headings, lists, tables) is not interpreted, so a value like '1. Quartal 2024' stays literal.

titleScenarios.description: List of scenarios displayed in card header. Can be a YAML array or a comma-separated string. If empty, the scenarios are omitted. Values: ac1-ac4, fc1-fc4, pp1-pp4, pl1-pl4. Set to 'inherited-page' to inherit from the parent LayoutPage's titleScenarios.

titleVariances.description: List of variances calculated from the given scenarios. Can be a YAML array or a comma-separated string. The scenarios used in the variances must also be defined in the scenarios property. Pattern: d[scenarioB]_[scenarioA]_[pos/neg/neu]. Set to 'inherited-page' to inherit from the parent LayoutPage's titleVariances.

titleOrder.description: Primary scenario on which the order direction is applied. If order is set to a scenario, it must also exist in the scenario list. Set to 'inherited-page' to inherit from the parent LayoutPage.

titleOrderDirection.description: Sets the sorting order direction. Set to 'inherited-page' to inherit from the parent LayoutPage.

titleMeasures.description: Array of measure objects with name and unit. Can be a YAML array or a JSON string. Example: [{"name": "Bruttoumsatz", "unit": "mEUR"}]

titleDateStart.description: Start date in yyyy-MM-dd format (e.g. 2023-01-01) or ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. 2023-01-01T14:30:00Z).

titleDateEnd.description: End date in yyyy-MM-dd format (e.g. 2023-12-31) or ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. 2023-12-31T23:59:59Z).

titleDateFormat.description: Date format. year: 'YYYY', quarter: 'Q[Q] YYYY', month: 'MMM YYYY', week: '[KW]WW YYYY', day: 'DD.MM.YYYY', time: 'DD.MM.YYYY HH:mm:ss', none: 'DD.MM.YYYY', auto: automatic detection.

titleDateLink.description: Format in which the start and end date are linked. avg: 'Ø[DATE]', interval: '[DATE]..[DATE2]', start: '.[DATE]', end: '[DATE].', ytd: '_[DATE]', ytg: '[DATE]_', cum: '[DATE]_[DATE2]', mat: '~[DATE]', none: '[DATE]'.

titleNamespace.description: Deprecated: use i18nNamespace. Namespace used for title translations only; never applies to children.

i18nNamespace.description: I18n namespace for the card title and, via inheritance, all children (their own i18nNamespace wins). Takes precedence over the deprecated titleNamespace.

footerText.description: Footer text displayed at the bottom of the card.

cardLayout.description: Layout mode for arranging child components within the card.

cardCustomTemplate.description: CSS grid-template-areas string for custom-template layout mode.

cardGridGap.description: Gap between grid cells (CSS gap value).

cardFitToContent.description: When true, the card shrinks to fit its content. When false (default), it stretches to fill its parent. Use false when the card contains auto-scaling components.

cardShowBorder.description: Whether to display the card border.

children.description: Child components to render inside the card slots.

kind.description: The type of component to render. Must match the kind of the referenced document when using ref.

metadata.description: Optional metadata for the child component, including name and constraints.

ref.description: Reference to a standalone document by name (metadata.name). When set, the referenced document's spec is used as the base, and any spec fields provided here act as overrides. The referenced document must have a kind matching this child's kind. LayoutPage cannot be referenced.

optional.description: When true and the ref is missing, the child is skipped gracefully instead of erroring.

params.description: Parameter values passed to the referenced document, expanded as ${NAME} in its spec. Keys should match parameter names declared in the referenced document's metadata.params. Only valid together with ref.

spec.description: Component specification. Required for inline children (without ref). When ref is set, spec fields override the referenced document's spec values.

imageSpec.description: Configuration for an Image component. Displays an image from an asset name or URL.

selectedStyle.description: Name of a ComponentStyle manifest (metadata.name) to apply to this component. The effective style merges _system, then _default, then the named style. Maps to the selected-style HTML attribute.

source.description: Name of an Asset document (kind: Asset) or URL of the image. If not http, it looks up the asset by name. If empty string ('') or null, the image is omitted.

layoutChildMetadata.description: Metadata for inline layout children (children of LayoutPage and LayoutCard).

name.description: Optional name for the inline child component. Used in error messages and for identification.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the child component. Documentation only; not rendered.

oneOf.description: String format constraint: 'field operator value', e.g., 'mode==preview', 'labels.env in [dev,staging]'

operator.description: Comparison operator: '==' (equals), '!=' (not equals), 'in' (value in array), 'not-in' (value not in array)

value.description: Value to compare: string or boolean for ==, !=; string array for in, not-in

oneOf.description: Structured format constraint with field, operator, and value

constraints.description: Constraint expressions that determine if this child is included for a specific ReportArtefact. Each constraint is evaluated against the target artefact's labels, spec, and the current mode (build/preview/serve). All constraints must match for inclusion. Supports both string format ('mode==preview', 'labels.env in [dev,staging]') and structured format ({field: 'mode', operator: '==', value: 'preview'}).

selectedStyle.description: Name of a ComponentStyle manifest (metadata.name) to apply to this component. The effective style merges _system, then _default, then the named style. Maps to the selected-style HTML attribute.

ruleset.description: Name of a RuleSet manifest (metadata.name) selecting the IBCS scenario rule set, or 'inherited-closest' / 'inherited-page' to reuse the rule set of the surrounding layout. The effective rule set merges _system, then _default, then the named rule set. Maps to the ruleset HTML attribute.

filter.description: An AlaSQL WHERE-clause fragment applied to the chart's data to filter rows before rendering, e.g. "rowGroup = 'Revenue'".

level.description: Determines the level on which the chart is aggregated. Index variants preserve the original dataset order. When set to 'auto', the level is detected from the dataset silently; when left blank, it is detected with a warning.

order.description: Primary scenario on which the order direction is applied. If order is set to a scenario, it must also exist in the scenario list. Set to 'inherited-closest' to inherit from the nearest ancestor LayoutCard or LayoutPage, or 'inherited-page' to inherit from the LayoutPage only.

orderDirection.description: Sets the sorting order direction. Set to 'inherited-closest' or 'inherited-page' to inherit from an ancestor LayoutCard or LayoutPage.

measureScale.description: Sets the SI prefix of measurements and converts the original value. '_' means no prefix. 'GREATEST' finds the largest value, 'LEAST' finds the smallest value in the dataset.

measureUnit.description: Measure unit displayed in the chart.

percentageScaling.description: Name of the scaling-group or a number representing the pixel per percentage.

unitScaling.description: Name of the scaling-group or a number representing the pixel per measure unit.

i18nNamespace.description: I18n namespace consulted for this component's labels; keys missing there fall back to '_system'. Resolved at runtime from the nearest ancestor carrying one (card, page, tree, grid, or the artefact) when not set. Maps to the i18n-namespace HTML attribute.

showMeasureScale.description: Toggles display of measure units in chart header.

limit.description: Maximum number of bars for each group. 0 means no limit. Rows cut by the limit are cumulated as REST.

scale.description: Proportional scaling of the chart. 'none': no scaling. 'auto': auto-scale silently to fit parent. A positive number (e.g. '0.8'): fixed factor. When omitted, auto-scales and warns with the applied factor.

scenarios.description: List of scenarios. Up to 4 different scenarios supported. Can be a YAML array or a JSON/CSV string. Values: ac1-4, fc1-4, pp1-4, pl1-4. Set to 'inherited-closest' to inherit from the nearest ancestor LayoutCard or LayoutPage, or 'inherited-page' to inherit from the LayoutPage only.

variances.description: List of variances calculated from the given scenarios. Pattern: d[scenarioB]_[scenarioA]_[pos/neg/neu]. Can be a YAML array or a JSON string. Set to 'inherited-closest' to inherit from the nearest ancestor LayoutCard or LayoutPage, or 'inherited-page' to inherit from the LayoutPage only.

stack.description: Configures stacked bar rendering. When set, bars are stacked instead of shown side-by-side.

by.description: Stacking dimension. 'scenarios' stacks scenario slots end-to-end. 'dimensions' auto-derives the stack column from the level prop (rowGroup→category, category→subCategory).

mode.description: Stacking mode. 'absolute': additive values. 'relative': 100% stacked. 'absolute-relative': absolute height with percentage labels.

selectedStyle.description: Name of a ComponentStyle manifest (metadata.name) to apply to this component. The effective style merges _system, then _default, then the named style. Maps to the selected-style HTML attribute.

ruleset.description: Name of a RuleSet manifest (metadata.name) selecting the IBCS scenario rule set, or 'inherited-closest' / 'inherited-page' to reuse the rule set of the surrounding layout. The effective rule set merges _system, then _default, then the named rule set. Maps to the ruleset HTML attribute.

axisLabelsMode.description: Axis labels mode. 'smart' only displays relevant information when a change/transition occurs (e.g., year displayed only on Jan 1st). 'long' and 'short' use respective date styles.

order.description: Primary scenario on which the order direction is applied. If order is set to a scenario, it must also exist in the scenario list. Set to 'inherited-closest' to inherit from the nearest ancestor LayoutCard or LayoutPage, or 'inherited-page' to inherit from the LayoutPage only.

orderDirection.description: Sets the sorting order direction. Set to 'inherited-closest' or 'inherited-page' to inherit from an ancestor LayoutCard or LayoutPage.

measureUnit.description: Measure unit displayed in the chart.

i18nNamespace.description: I18n namespace consulted for this component's labels; keys missing there fall back to '_system'. Resolved at runtime from the nearest ancestor carrying one (card, page, tree, grid, or the artefact) when not set. Maps to the i18n-namespace HTML attribute.

showMeasureScale.description: Toggles display of measure units in chart header.

limit.description: Maximum number of column stacks. 0 means no limit. Column stacks cut by the limit are cumulated as REST.

intervalSpanLimit.description: Max number of columns used to calculate axis date interval (if dateInterval is set to 'auto').

percentageScaling.description: Name of the scaling-group or a number representing the pixel per percentage.

unitScaling.description: Name of the scaling-group or a number representing the pixel per measure unit.

syncSpaceLeft.description: Left side offset for horizontal sync.

scale.description: Proportional scaling of the chart. 'none': no scaling. 'auto': auto-scale silently to fit parent. A positive number (e.g. '0.8'): fixed factor. When omitted, auto-scales and warns with the applied factor.

Set to 'inherited-closest' to inherit from the nearest ancestor LayoutCard or LayoutPage, or 'inherited-page' to inherit from the LayoutPage only.

variances.description: List of variances calculated from the given scenarios. Pattern: d[scenarioB]_[scenarioA]_[pos/neg/neu]. Can be a YAML array or a JSON string. Set to 'inherited-closest' to inherit from the nearest ancestor LayoutCard or LayoutPage, or 'inherited-page' to inherit from the LayoutPage only.

chartMode.description: Controls how the chart is rendered. 'bar' for standard bar chart, 'line' for line chart with markers, 'auto' to switch to line mode when data points exceed maxBars.

maxBars.description: Threshold for auto-switching to line mode. Only applies when chartMode is 'auto'.

lineFullWidth.description: When true, line charts stretch to fill the full parent width instead of using fixed per-data-point spacing. Has no effect in bar mode.

stack.description: Configures stacked column/area rendering. When set with chartMode 'bar', renders stacked columns. When set with chartMode 'line', renders stacked area chart.

by.description: Stacking dimension. 'scenarios' stacks scenario slots end-to-end. 'dimensions' auto-derives the stack column from the level prop (rowGroup→category, category→subCategory).

mode.description: Stacking mode. 'absolute': additive values. 'relative': 100% stacked. 'absolute-relative': absolute height with percentage labels.

xyMeasureToken.description: Scenario slot (ac1-ac4, pp1-pp4, fc1-fc4, pl1-pl4) or variance token: d[base]_[delta] for absolute or dr[base]_[delta] for relative variance, with an optional _pos/_neg/_neu sentiment suffix (ignored on axes). Examples: ac1, dac1_pp1, drac1_pl1.

xyAxisMapping.description: Axis measure mapping. Either a bare measure token (shorthand for { measure: token }) or an object with the measure plus optional axis settings.

label.description: Axis title displayed next to the axis.

unit.description: Unit suffix displayed after the axis title, e.g. 'mEUR' or '% of net sales'. Values are drawn as delivered - scale in the DataSet SQL.

min.description: Lower axis domain bound. Points outside an explicit domain are clipped with a warning.

max.description: Upper axis domain bound. Must be greater than min or both overrides are dropped.

refLine.description: Draws a reference line perpendicular to this axis at the given value.

highlight.description: Shades a band of the plot along this axis. Open ends run to the domain edge.

xyIso.description: Hyperbolic iso-lines x*y = k for a third derived measure. Requires a strictly positive domain on both axes.

values.description: Iso-line constants: 'auto' derives them from the data, or provide explicit k values.

label.description: Caption of the derived measure, rendered at the iso-line exits.

unit.description: Unit suffix for the iso-line caption.

highlight.description: Shades the region where x*y >= from.

from.description: Iso value the shading starts at.

xyFacet.description: Splits the plot into small-multiple panels on a hierarchy level above the series level.

level.description: Hierarchy level whose values become the facet panels.

columns.description: Number of panels per row. Omitted renders all panels in one row.

xyLabels.description: Point label configuration. Defaults differ per kind: ChartScatter uses points 'auto' without values, ChartBubble labels all bubbles with values.

points.description: Which points get a name label: 'auto' picks up to max collision-free candidates, 'all' labels every point, 'none' disables labels, or list explicit point names.

values.description: Render the measure value with the label (inside the bubble for ChartBubble).

show.description: Toggles the legend. Defaults to true.

chartScatterSpecBase.description: Configuration for a ChartScatter component: an XY scattergram with two numeric value axes, points colored by series, selective proximate labels, optional highlight bands, and hyperbolic iso-lines.

selectedStyle.description: Name of a ComponentStyle manifest (metadata.name) to apply to this component. The effective style merges _system, then _default, then the named style. Maps to the selected-style HTML attribute.

i18nNamespace.description: I18n namespace consulted for this component's labels; keys missing there fall back to '_system'. Resolved at runtime from the nearest ancestor carrying one (card, page, tree, grid, or the artefact) when not set. Maps to the i18n-namespace HTML attribute.

ruleset.description: Name of a RuleSet manifest (metadata.name) selecting the IBCS scenario rule set, or 'inherited-closest' / 'inherited-page' to reuse the rule set of the surrounding layout. The effective rule set merges _system, then _default, then the named rule set. Maps to the ruleset HTML attribute.

filter.description: An AlaSQL WHERE-clause fragment applied to the chart's data to filter rows before rendering, e.g. "category = 'New SBUs'".

x.description: Horizontal axis measure mapping: a bare measure token or an object with measure, label, unit, min, max, refLine, and highlight. All plain scenario measures across x and y must share one scenario family.

y.description: Vertical axis measure mapping: a bare measure token or an object with measure, label, unit, min, max, refLine, and highlight.

iso.description: Hyperbolic iso-lines x*y = k for a third derived measure. Maps to the iso HTML attribute.

level.description: Hierarchy level that identifies one point (one row = one point, duplicates are dropped with a warning). 'auto' uses the deepest populated level.

seriesLevel.description: Hierarchy level whose values become the color series. Must be strictly above the point level; 'auto' uses the point level's parent, 'none' renders a single series. Maps to the series-level HTML attribute.

facet.description: Small-multiple panels on a level above the series level.

labels.description: Point label configuration. Defaults to auto-picked collision-free name labels (max 12) without values.

aspect.description: Plot aspect ratio as 'w:h', e.g. '16:9' (the default). XY charts have no data-driven height.

limit.description: Maximum number of points per facet panel, keeping the first rows in dataset order. 0 means no limit.

scale.description: Proportional scaling of the chart. 'none': no scaling. 'auto': auto-scale silently to fit parent. A positive number (e.g. '0.8'): fixed factor. When omitted, auto-scales and warns with the applied factor.

chartBubbleSpecBase.description: Configuration for a ChartBubble component: an XY portfolio chart with area-true bubbles sized by a third measure, optional pie-share slices, and a comparison-scenario overlay.

selectedStyle.description: Name of a ComponentStyle manifest (metadata.name) to apply to this component. The effective style merges _system, then _default, then the named style. Maps to the selected-style HTML attribute.

i18nNamespace.description: I18n namespace consulted for this component's labels; keys missing there fall back to '_system'. Resolved at runtime from the nearest ancestor carrying one (card, page, tree, grid, or the artefact) when not set. Maps to the i18n-namespace HTML attribute.

ruleset.description: Name of a RuleSet manifest (metadata.name) selecting the IBCS scenario rule set, or 'inherited-closest' / 'inherited-page' to reuse the rule set of the surrounding layout. The effective rule set merges _system, then _default, then the named rule set. Maps to the ruleset HTML attribute.

filter.description: An AlaSQL WHERE-clause fragment applied to the chart's data to filter rows before rendering, e.g. "category = 'New SBUs'".

x.description: Horizontal axis measure mapping: a bare measure token or an object with measure, label, unit, min, max, refLine, and highlight. All plain scenario measures across x, y, size, and share must share one scenario family.

y.description: Vertical axis measure mapping: a bare measure token or an object with measure, label, unit, min, max, refLine, and highlight.

size.description: Bubble size measure: a bare measure token or an object. Bubble area is proportional to the value; values must be >= 0 (negative values drop the point with a warning).

label.description: Caption of the size measure in the size legend.

unit.description: Unit suffix for the size legend.

group.description: Name of a ScalingGroup manifest (metadata.name) for cross-chart value-to-area synchronization. Every chart referencing the same group renders an identical value-to-area mapping; the group value is the bubble area in px^2 per data unit. An unknown group name is a blocking render error.

share.description: Pie-share measure: a fraction between 0 and 1 rendered as a pie slice from 12 o'clock in the hue's dark shade. A bare measure token or an object with a measure.

compareWith.description: Comparison scenario family rendered as a structural overlay behind the primary bubbles. Reads the same slot numbers of the comparison family (e.g. x ac1 compares against pp1). Must differ from the primary scenario family; not allowed when an axis uses a variance token. Maps to the compare-with HTML attribute.

level.description: Hierarchy level that identifies one bubble (one row = one bubble, duplicates are dropped with a warning). 'auto' uses the deepest populated level.

seriesLevel.description: Hierarchy level whose values become the color series. Must be strictly above the point level; 'auto' uses the point level's parent, 'none' renders a single series. Maps to the series-level HTML attribute.

facet.description: Small-multiple panels on a level above the series level.

labels.description: Bubble label configuration. Defaults to labeling all bubbles with contrast-colored values (hidden when they do not fit).

legend.description: Series legend configuration. The bubble chart additionally renders a size legend (and a compare legend when compareWith is set).

aspect.description: Plot aspect ratio as 'w:h', e.g. '16:9' (the default). XY charts have no data-driven height.

limit.description: Maximum number of bubbles per facet panel, keeping the largest by size. 0 means no limit.

scale.description: Proportional scaling of the chart. 'none': no scaling. 'auto': auto-scale silently to fit parent. A positive number (e.g. '0.8'): fixed factor. When omitted, auto-scales and warns with the applied factor. Note: a fixed factor also scales bubble areas from a ScalingGroup (factor squared).

scenarioSlotToken.description: Plain scenario slot (ac1-ac4, pp1-pp4, fc1-fc4, pl1-pl4). Variance tokens are not allowed here — the bullet variance is implicit (actual vs target). Examples: ac1, pl1.

bulletMeasureMapping.description: Bullet measure mapping. Either a bare scenario slot (shorthand for { measure: slot }) or an object with the measure plus an optional label and unit.

label.description: Caption of the measure, shown above the first row (actual) or at the target line (target).

unit.description: Unit caption rendered once as 'in <unit>' in the chart header. Values are drawn as delivered - scale in the DataSet SQL.

chartBulletSpecBase.description: Configuration for a ChartBullet component: an IBCS bullet graph with one row per KPI, a solid actual bar, and a target marker. The default mode normalizes targets (one aligned target line across rows) and draws integrated variance bars; the classic Stephen Few look is opt-in via normalize 'none' and ranges.

selectedStyle.description: Name of a ComponentStyle manifest (metadata.name) to apply to this component. The effective style merges _system, then _default, then the named style. Maps to the selected-style HTML attribute.

i18nNamespace.description: I18n namespace consulted for this component's labels; keys missing there fall back to '_system'. Resolved at runtime from the nearest ancestor carrying one (card, page, tree, grid, or the artefact) when not set. Maps to the i18n-namespace HTML attribute.

ruleset.description: Name of a RuleSet manifest (metadata.name) selecting the IBCS scenario rule set, or 'inherited-closest' / 'inherited-page' to reuse the rule set of the surrounding layout. The effective rule set merges _system, then _default, then the named rule set. Maps to the ruleset HTML attribute.

filter.description: An AlaSQL WHERE-clause fragment applied to the chart's data to filter rows before rendering, e.g. "rowGroup = 'Revenue'".

actual.description: Actual-value measure: a bare scenario slot or an object with measure, label, and unit. Omitted auto-detects ac1 (else the first available scenario).

target.description: Target measure: a bare scenario slot or an object with measure, label, and unit. Omitted auto-detects pl1 > pp1 > fc1; without any target scenario the chart renders actual bars only.

ranges.description: Qualitative range bands as ascending fractions of the target, e.g. [0.6, 0.9]. At most two bands (IBCS rejects a third band of arbitrary length). Classic mode only - ignored while normalize is 'target'.

normalize.description: Target normalization. 'target' (the default) scales every row to fractions of its target so one continuous target line spans all rows; 'none' draws classic per-row scales with tick strips.

variances.description: Variance bars between actual and target. 'auto' (the default) draws them in normalized mode, favorable/unfavorable per the IBCS variance colors; 'none' disables them.

level.description: Hierarchy level that identifies one KPI row. 'auto' uses the deepest populated level.

order.description: Sort key of the KPI rows. Omitted or 'auto' uses the dataset's suggested order.

orderDirection.description: Sorting direction. Maps to the order-direction HTML attribute.

limit.description: Maximum number of KPI rows, keeping the first rows in sort order. Truncates without a REST aggregate. 0 means no limit.

labels.description: Value label configuration, e.g. { show: 'auto', decimals: 1 }.

show.description: Toggles the value labels right of the bars. Defaults to 'auto'.

decimals.description: Decimal places of the value labels. Defaults to 1.

scale.description: Proportional scaling of the chart. 'none': no scaling. 'auto': auto-scale silently to fit parent. A positive number (e.g. '0.8'): fixed factor. When omitted, auto-scales and warns with the applied factor.

treeSpecBase.description: Configuration for a Tree component. Trees display hierarchical structures with nodes connected by edges, commonly used for driver trees and decomposition diagrams.

selectedStyle.description: Name of a ComponentStyle manifest (metadata.name) to apply to this component. The effective style merges _system, then _default, then the named style. Maps to the selected-style HTML attribute.

i18nNamespace.description: I18n namespace inherited by the children of this container at runtime (their own i18nNamespace wins). Resolved from the enclosing artefact/page/card when not set. Maps to the i18n-namespace HTML attribute.

edges.description: JSON array defining connections between nodes. Each edge specifies a source (from) and target (to) node ID, with optional operator and styling.

oneOf.description: JSON string containing array of edge objects.

operator.description: Mathematical operator displayed between sibling nodes.

label.description: Custom label to display instead of operator symbol.

oneOf.description: Array of edge objects defining the tree structure.

levelSpacing.description: Spacing between hierarchy levels in pixels.

nodeSpacing.description: Spacing between sibling nodes in pixels.

edgeStyle.description: Edge line style: 'straight' (direct lines), 'orthogonal' (right-angle lines), 'curved' (bezier curves).

showOperators.description: Show operator symbols between sibling nodes.

nodes.description: Array of node definitions with content for each node in the tree.

treeNode.description: A node in the tree chart. Each node can contain a Label, Table, ChartStructure, ChartTime, ChartScatter, ChartBubble, ChartBullet, Image, or LayoutCard component, either inline or by reference.

id.description: Unique identifier for the node, matching 'from' or 'to' values in edges.

kind.description: The type of component to render in this node.

ref.description: Reference to a standalone document by name (metadata.name). When set, the referenced document's spec is used. Only valid for Table, ChartStructure, ChartTime, ChartScatter, ChartBubble, ChartBullet, Image, and LayoutCard kinds.

optional.description: When true and the ref is missing, the node is skipped gracefully instead of erroring.

params.description: Parameter values passed to the referenced document, expanded as ${NAME} in its spec. Keys should match parameter names declared in the referenced document's metadata.params. Only valid together with ref.

spec.description: Component specification. Required for Label kind and inline definitions. When ref is set, spec fields override the referenced document's spec values.

treeLabelSpec.description: Configuration for a Label component in a tree node. Labels display simple text or HTML content.

value.description: Text or HTML content to display in the label.

dataset.description: Optional dataset binding for template interpolation in the value.

scale.description: Font-size scaling mode. "none" disables scaling, "auto" auto-scales silently, a positive number (e.g. "0.8") sets an explicit factor. When omitted, auto-scales and warns with the applied factor.

gridSpecBase.description: Configuration for a Grid component. Grids create CSS grid-based layouts with row and column headers for organizing child components in a tabular structure.

selectedStyle.description: Name of a ComponentStyle manifest (metadata.name) to apply to this component. The effective style merges _system, then _default, then the named style. Maps to the selected-style HTML attribute.

i18nNamespace.description: I18n namespace inherited by the children of this container at runtime (their own i18nNamespace wins). Resolved from the enclosing artefact/page/card when not set. Maps to the i18n-namespace HTML attribute.

chartTitle.description: Title displayed at the top-left of the grid. If empty, the title area is omitted.

rowHeaders.description: Row header definitions. Can be an array of strings (auto-generated numeric IDs) or objects with label and id properties.

oneOf.description: Simple array of row header labels. IDs are auto-generated as '0', '1', '2', etc.

label.description: Display text for the row header.

id.description: Unique identifier for the row, used in cell references.

oneOf.description: Array of row header objects with explicit IDs.

columnHeaders.description: Column header definitions. Can be an array of strings (auto-generated numeric IDs) or objects with label and id properties.

oneOf.description: Simple array of column header labels. IDs are auto-generated as '0', '1', '2', etc.

label.description: Display text for the column header.

id.description: Unique identifier for the column, used in cell references.

oneOf.description: Array of column header objects with explicit IDs.

showBorders.description: Whether to display border/divider lines between cells.

rowHeaderWidth.description: CSS width of the row header column (e.g., 'auto', '100px', '20%').

children.description: Array of child definitions. Each child specifies its grid position and content.

gridChild.description: A child (cell) in the grid. Each child specifies its position (row and column) and content, which can be a reference to an existing component or an inline definition.

row.description: Row identifier. Must match a row ID from rowHeaders (or auto-generated index like 0, 1). Can be string or integer.

column.description: Column identifier. Must match a column ID from columnHeaders (or auto-generated index like 0, 1). Can be string or integer.

kind.description: The type of component to render in this child.

metadata.description: Optional metadata for the child component, including name and constraints.

ref.description: Reference to a standalone document by name (metadata.name). When set, the referenced document's spec is used as the base.

optional.description: When true and the ref is missing, the child is skipped gracefully instead of erroring.

params.description: Parameter values passed to the referenced document, expanded as ${NAME} in its spec. Keys should match parameter names declared in the referenced document's metadata.params. Only valid together with ref.

spec.description: Component specification. Required for inline children (without ref). When ref is set, spec fields override the referenced document's spec values.

selectedStyle.description: Name of a ComponentStyle manifest (metadata.name) to apply to this component. The effective style merges _system, then _default, then the named style. Maps to the selected-style HTML attribute.

ruleset.description: Name of a RuleSet manifest (metadata.name) selecting the IBCS scenario rule set, or 'inherited-closest' / 'inherited-page' to reuse the rule set of the surrounding layout. The effective rule set merges _system, then _default, then the named rule set. Maps to the ruleset HTML attribute.

sumTitle.description: Label of the grand-total row at the bottom of the table. Only rendered for 'type: sum' and 'type: opt'; the other table types have no total row and ignore this value. Defaults to the IBCS total symbol when empty. Maps to the sum-title HTML attribute.

filter.description: An AlaSQL WHERE-clause fragment applied to the table's data to filter rows before rendering, e.g. "category = 'Sales'".

order.description: Primary scenario on which the order direction is applied. If order is set to a scenario, it must also exist in the scenario list. Set to 'inherited-closest' to inherit from the nearest ancestor LayoutCard or LayoutPage, or 'inherited-page' to inherit from the LayoutPage only.

orderDirection.description: Sets the sorting order direction. Set to 'inherited-closest' or 'inherited-page' to inherit from an ancestor LayoutCard or LayoutPage.

measureScale.description: Sets the SI prefix of measurements and converts the original value. '_' means no prefix. 'GREATEST' finds the largest value, 'LEAST' finds the smallest value in the dataset.

measureType.description: Sets the measure type of the table. Volume is displayed and interpreted differently than currency, and SI prefix names are adapted accordingly.

measureUnit.description: Measure unit displayed in the table.

i18nNamespace.description: I18n namespace consulted for this component's labels; keys missing there fall back to '_system'. Resolved at runtime from the nearest ancestor carrying one (card, page, tree, grid, or the artefact) when not set. Maps to the i18n-namespace HTML attribute.

categoryWidth.description: Width of the category column. 'inf' scales columns to the minimum space they need separately.

dataFormat.description: Defines the data unit type. If 'percent' is chosen, all data values are converted to percent (0.02 -> 2%).

dataFormatDigitsDecimal.description: Number of decimal digits in a table cell.

dataFormatDigitsPercent.description: Number of percent digits in a table cell.

grouped.description: Toggles whether data should be grouped by 'rowgroup'.

showGroupTitle.description: Toggles a title header for each row group. The title value is found by 'rowgroup'.

showMeasureScale.description: Toggles display of measure units in table header.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows for each group. 0 means no limit. Rows cut by the limit are cumulated as REST.

type.description: Sets the table type. Only 'sum' and 'opt' render a grand-total row at the bottom of the table, labelled by 'sumTitle'. Defaults to 'list'.

scenarios.description: List of scenarios displayed in the table. Can be a YAML array or a JSON string. Set to 'inherited-closest' to inherit from the nearest ancestor LayoutCard or LayoutPage, or 'inherited-page' to inherit from the LayoutPage only.

variances.description: List of variances calculated from the given scenarios. The scenarios used must be defined in the 'scenarios' property. Pattern: d[scenarioB]_[scenarioA]_[pos/neg/neu]. Can be a YAML array or a JSON string. Set to 'inherited-closest' to inherit from the nearest ancestor LayoutCard or LayoutPage, or 'inherited-page' to inherit from the LayoutPage only.

barColumns.description: List of column names to render as inline IBCS-compliant bar charts instead of numbers. Supports variance columns (d_ prefix for absolute, dr_ prefix for relative) and scenario columns (ac, pp, fc, pl).

barColumnWidth.description: Maximum width of inline bar/pin chart columns in em. Default: w10.

unitScaling.description: Pixels per unit for absolute variance bars (d_ prefix columns). Controls the width of the bars.

percentageScaling.description: Pixels per percentage point for relative variance pins (dr_ prefix columns). Controls the width of the pin charts.

scale.description: Proportional scaling of the entire table (font, spacing, bars, pins, patterns). Blank or not set: auto-scale to fit parent width with warning. 'none': no scaling. 'auto': auto-scale silently. A positive number (e.g. '0.5', '1.2'): fixed factor applied to the base font size.

thereof.description: Array of drilldown objects with rowGroup, category, and subCategory. Can be a YAML array or a JSON string. Example: [{"rowGroup":"Umsatz", "category": "Applications", "subCategory": "Applications-A"}]

partof.description: Array of part-of objects with rowGroup and category defining the drill percentage location. Can be a YAML array or a JSON string. Example: [{"rowGroup":"Umsatz", "category": "Applications"}]

columnthereof.description: Defines which drill-column is displayed. Can be a YAML array or a JSON string. Example: [{"scenario": "ac1", "name": "DE", "subGroups": ["Berlin"]}]

interval.description: Repeats the entire scenario/variance column block once per interval group, rendered under a spanning header band (e.g. '2023 | 2024 | 2025'). 'none' (default) disables the feature. 'setname' groups by the dataset's setname column (blank setnames are grouped under '—'). Date values ('year'..'millisecond') bucket rows by the date column; 'auto' detects the granularity from the date span. Cannot be combined with columnthereof (columnthereof wins).

attributes.description: Computed attribute columns rendered between the category and scenario columns, in list order. Maps a column header label to an aggregate expression over the rows behind each table row. Functions: set, first, last, min, max, avg, sum (dataset field or custom '_'-prefixed field) and lit (constant). Use the ordered array form, or a JSON object string whose key order defines column order. Example: [{"label": "Verkaufsleiter", "expression": "set(_leiter)"}]

expression.description: Aggregate expression: set|first|last|min|max|avg|sum(field) where field is a dataset column or a custom field prefixed with '_', or lit(constant).
